name: Aura
description: A Git-native open-source IDE designed for working with AI coding agents, featuring semantic version control for agents, tracking of AI-generated changes at function/class level, and comparison tools for managing AI code modifications.

name: IBM Bob Multi-Agent Platform
description: IBM announced major updates to its agentic software development platform Bob, introducing coordinated multi-agent capabilities with parallel tool calling, isolated context windows for complex work, and Bobalytics for AI cost and usage analytics.
